snippet.title: Wild Wild Eden – Official Trailer | Open-World Survival Crafting RPG
snippet.description:
🚨 Wild Wild Eden is here — 
a tame-and-craft survival adventure set in a vast open world.
With friends, or on your own. Explore a sprawling planet, 
gather resources, tame monsters, and build a home base that's all your own.

▼ About Wild Wild Eden
Wild Wild Eden is an open-world survival-craft game set in a primal fantasy world. 
Its heart lies in the ""family""-like bond you form with the monsters around you.
 Pet them, shower them with affection, and share meals together. 
As the chief of your tribe, 
you'll raise these beloved companions and work alongside them to grow and enrich your base.
A new kind of survival — harsh, yet heartwarming.

▼ Steam® Page (Wishlist now open)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478130/Wild_Wild_Eden/
▼ Official Site
https://shueisha-games.com/games/wildwildeden/
